subject: Synthesis: AtlasPay integration outage — OKR impacts and escalation runway
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasPay tokenization errors — initial containment and impact

Team,

Quick summary of what happened this morning (high level):
- At 08:02 PT we started seeing elevated 5xx rates on the AtlasPay tokenization route (router: /v1/tokenize).
- The increase correlated with a change in AtlasPay's client certificate rotation; our mutual TLS handshake path failed for ~18 minutes before automatic fallback started.
- Customer-visible impact: intermittent failures for 41 paying customers, median downstream latency spiked from 120ms to 1.8s during the window.

What we did immediately:
- Re-routed traffic via the legacy TLS pool at 08:20 PT (temporary mitigation).
- Throttled batch ingestion for the affected account class to reduce queueing.
- Collected full stacks and KV cache snapshots; bundle attached (incident_logs.tgz).

Open items (initial):
1) Confirm rollback window and scope for the certificate validation change with AtlasPay (owner: Marissa).
2) Validate cache invalidation logic that may have amplified tail latency (owner: Rishi).
3) Quantify customer minutes of degradation and surface to finance/sales for any credit exposure (owner: Vivek).

I’ll maintain a running action register and post updates to the Drive link. Will follow up with a short executive summary for QBR prep.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior SRE
Redwood Inference

Attachments: incident_logs.tgz (log bundle, 120MB, stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasPay tokenization errors — initial containment and impact

Thanks Marissa — useful first pass. For leadership/QBR we need three things by EOD Monday:
- Short-read slide (1 slide) with user impact buckets (downtime minutes, failed requests, top affected SKUs) — owner: Marissa.
- OKR delta assessment: which production SLAs/OKRs were missed and the projected quarter-end delta if mitigations are not accelerated — owner: Rishi.
- Customer remediation stance and proposed credits/appeasement language to feed Sales — owner: Vivek.

Specific asks: please mark any work that will cross into other teams (SDK, infra, billing) so we can flag cross-functional blockers in the QBR.

On cadence: I want a 15-minute alignment call Monday 08:30 PT to run through the slide and the recommended leadership statement. If any of you cannot make that time, flag now.

On the mitigation path: if we believe the fallback routing is stable but fragile, we should prepare an automated fallback policy to be shipped in the next two weeks (this will be an OKR candidate to reduce single-point handshake failures).

Thanks,

--
Hannah Schmitt
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasPay tokenization errors — proposed escalation & credit runway

Hannah — looping in a recommended path for execs and Sales as we prep the QBR:
1) Customer restitution: recommend a standard three-tier credit table (minor/major/critical) based on minutes of impact and revenue exposure. I’ll draft suggested wording for Sales to use; target: 48-hour turnaround for final language.
2) Short-term operational runway: approve a small SRE/infra task force to harden mTLS fallback and add an automated failover config. Estimated 2 sprints (6 business days) to deliver canary + rollout.
3) OKR candidate: add a measurable objective to reduce handshake-induced customer errors by 90% for p95 latency within the quarter. This is time-limited and should be included in next OKR sync if we want it on QBR slides.

I’ve opened INF-7891 to track the automation work (link below). Also note: Procurement at AtlasPay is asking for a formal incident timeline for their audit — we should include a one-page timeline in the exec summary.

Regards,

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, AtlasPay Support <support@atlaspay.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Action register and status update (AtlasPay incident)

Team — attaching a concise action register (action_register.csv) and status flags. Key items:
- Rishi: root cause shows an unexpected cert chain parsing edge-case in our TLS library; patch in dev branch. ETA for canary: 2028-08-04.
- Marissa: follow-up with AtlasPay on certificate rotation procedure; confirmed meeting with Jordan Lee on Monday 2028-07-30.
- Vivek: credit recommendation draft shared with Sales; awaiting review.

Status flags (red/amber/green):
- Customer credits: amber (Vivek)
- Automated fallback policy: amber (SRE + infra)
- Post-incident runbook updates: green (Marissa)

Small note on attachments: action_register.csv contains owner, ETA, status columns (CSV stub). I will update the Drive link after the Monday call.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior SRE
Redwood Inference

Attachments: action_register.csv (CSV, stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, AtlasPay Procurement <procurement@atlaspay.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Aug 2028 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Executive summary for QBR: AtlasPay outage (finalized)

Folks — final exec summary attached (exec_summary.pdf). This is the one-pager to include in the QBR packet; main decisions and asks are below:

Decisions:
- Approve SRE/infra task force to deliver automated failover canary (2 sprints).
- Approve template credit language; Vivek to finalize and hand to Sales by 2028-08-03.
- Add handshake-failure reduction objective as a stretch OKR for Product Ops this quarter.

Leadership asks (for the QBR slide):
- Revenue: Vivek to include projected credit exposure and impact to ARR.
- Ops: Rishi to present the root-cause and mitigation timeline (5m).
- CS/Sales: provide customer-facing summary and timeline for remediation (3m).

Notes for the board packet: we recommend presenting this as an operational run-rate risk (not a platform design failure) and highlighting the automation deliverables as the primary corrective action.

Next steps:
- Rishi to confirm canary schedule by EOD 2028-08-02.
- Vivek to share credit wording by 2028-08-03.
- Marissa to publish final timeline for AtlasPay rotation meeting notes to the Drive (done).

If there are no objections I’ll include this slide in the QBR packet.

Thanks — appreciate the fast coordination.

--
Hannah Schmitt
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: exec_summary.pdf (PDF, 1-page, stub)
